commons.description: Dr. Jill Biden and U.S. Ambassador to Laos Daniel Clune take part in a Baci ceremony at the U.S. Embassy in Vientiane, Laos, July 21, 2015. Also pictured are Valerie Biden Owens, Christie Vilsack, Senior Advisor for International Education, USAID, Sheila Nix, Chief of Staff to Dr. Biden, Cathy Russell, Global Ambassador for Women and Girls, and Principle Deputy Assistant Secretary of State Scot Ma
